partners.mechanism_chain: FN1 (HGNC:3711) —PRODUCES→ Fibronectin (GO:0005576); Fibronectin (GO:0005576) —DISRUPTS→ Extracellular matrix organization (GO:0030198); Extracellular matrix organization (GO:0030198) —LEADS_TO→ Glomerulopathy (HP:0000100); ITGA2B (HGNC:6090) —DISRUPTS→ Platelet aggregation (GO:0001801); ITGB3 (HGNC:6085) —DISRUPTS→ Platelet aggregation (GO:0001801); Platelet aggregation (GO:0001801) —LEADS_TO→ Thrombasthenia (HP:0001934). Mutations in FN1 lead to a dysfunctional fibronectin protein, disrupting extracellular matrix organization and causing glomerulopathy. Separately, mutations in ITGA2B and ITGB3 impair the integrin complex necessary for platelet aggregation, leading to Glanzmann thrombasthenia. The convergence is on the functional impact of these proteins within broader cellular processes (ECM organization and platelet aggregation) which share downstream consequences in terms of cellular function and integrity, ultimately manifesting as distinct but related pathologies.
